mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) indicates inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases by >0.5% in a month
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market, which is associated with increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates growing demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases by >5% in a month
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply side of the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases by >1% in a month
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is high and payroll employment (PAYEMS) is decreasing, it indicates a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 7% and PAYEMS decreases by >0.5% in a month
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% signals an accommodative monetary policy, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates strong consumer demand and a healthy labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases by >1% and UNRATE decreases by >0.2% in a month
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in GDP (GDPC1) signals strong economic growth, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
